PIK3CA.note: ATP-binding catalytic pocket of PI3K-alpha, co-crystallized with alpelisib (ligand code 1LT). InChIKey of 1LT (STUWGJZDJHPWGZ-LBPRGKRZSA-N) exactly matches alpelisib. Auto-search previously picked 9CMK (RAS-binding domain, unrelated molecular-glue pocket) — confirmed wrong and replaced with this manually-verified entry.

ESR1.note: Estrogen receptor alpha LBD, mutant L536S, resolution 1.48A. Ligand chemically confirmed via RCSB InChI match to a known ChEMBL mechanism-of-action inhibitor (find_pdb_structure_matching_known_ligand), not just any hetero group.

AR.note: Androgen receptor LBD, T877A mutant, bound with co-regulator peptide, resolution 1.42A. Note: this entry has an extra peptide chain (co-regulator) besides the receptor and small-molecule ligand - watch for this during receptor prep (strip_ligands_and_waters should only remove the small-molecule ligand/water, not the peptide chain).

CA2.note: Human carbonic anhydrase II, resolution 1.1A. Not a kinase - zinc metalloenzyme active site.

CDK2.note: CDK2 ATP-binding kinase pocket, resolution 1.6A. Ternary complex title mentions a second ligand (TW8672) - only seliciclib chemically confirmed via known-inhibitor match, verify only one small-molecule ligand ends up in the stripped receptor's box.

EGFR.note: EGFR kinase domain ATP-binding pocket, resolution 1.5A.

ABL1.note: ABL1 kinase domain, T315I mutant (imatinib-resistant clone), resolution 1.82A.

PARP1.note: PARP1 catalytic domain, resolution 1.7A. Not a kinase - DNA repair enzyme (synthetic lethality with BRCA mutations).

HDAC2.note: HDAC2, resolution 1.85A. Not a kinase - epigenetic enzyme (histone deacetylase), catalytic site typically involves a Zn2+ ion, watch strip_ligands_and_waters doesn't remove a catalytically-relevant metal ion along with crystallization additives.

PPARG.note: PPARgamma ligand-binding domain monomer (not the RXR heterodimer form seen in some other PPARG PDB entries), resolution 1.771A. Not a kinase, not oncology - nuclear receptor, diabetes target.

BRAF.note: BRAF(V600E) kinase domain, resolution 2.7A. TRYING THIS after 3OG7 (vemurafenib, 2.45A) FAILED redock RMSD (3.094A, > 2.0A threshold) - 3OG7 kept in git history/memory, not reused. If 5C9C also fails, next candidates in order: 4RZV (vemurafenib, R509H mutant, 2.994A), 5CT7 (RAF-265, 3.17A).
